card.name: Place or furniture nouns after 'at the'
card.fires_on: The noun naming a physical spot or piece of furniture that completes a location phrase, such as table, line, road, desk, bed, hall or field. It is strongest after 'at the', 'on a' or 'behind a' in general web text.
